description: Build the authenticated user dashboard and admin panel with all required features: user dashboard (rentals, payments, verification, support), admin panel (fleet management, bookings, users, finance, maintenance, promos, CMS, analytics) with role-based access, charts, and modern dashboard UI.
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx and register/page.tsx with authentication forms (email/password, Google OAuth button, WhatsApp OTP input), using react-hook-form + zod validation, and attractive split-screen layout

Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx with authenticated layout: collapsible sidebar navigation (different menus per role), top header with user avatar/notifications/search, breadcrumbs, and mobile bottom navigation bar

Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx as User Dashboard Home with: active rental card (vehicle info, remaining days, next payment), upcoming payments list, rental history summary, notification feed, estimated monthly earnings chart (Recharts), quick action buttons

Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/bookings/ pages: booking list (filterable by status), new booking flow (vehicle selection -> duration -> agreement -> payment), booking detail page with status timeline
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/rentals/ pages: active rentals with vehicle details, rental countdown, payment schedule, vehicle report button, return request flow

Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/checkpoint/ page with digital vehicle inspection: multi-step form for uploading photos (front, back, left, right, interior, odometer), checklist items (scratches, dents, cleanliness), notes input, and submission confirmation
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/payments/ pages: payment history table with filters, payment detail with invoice download, deposit tracking progress bar, installment schedule view
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/verification/ page with document upload flow: KTP upload, SIM upload, selfie upload, verification status indicator (pending/approved/rejected), re-upload option
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/support/ pages: ticket list, create new ticket form, ticket detail with chat-style messages, emergency help button with WhatsApp redirect
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/profile/ page with: personal info form, emergency contact form, password change, notification preferences toggles
Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx with admin-specific sidebar (fleet, bookings, users, finance, maintenance, promos, CMS, reports)

Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/dashboard/page.tsx as Admin Dashboard with: revenue overview cards, fleet utilization donut chart, active drivers count, monthly revenue bar chart (Recharts), recent bookings table, maintenance alerts, vehicle status breakdown

Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/fleet/ pages: vehicle list table with search/filter/pagination, add/edit vehicle form (multi-step: basic info -> photos upload -> pricing -> availability), vehicle detail view
Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/bookings/ pages: booking management table with approve/reject actions, booking detail with status management, vehicle assignment dropdown, rental extension form
Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/users/ pages: user list table with verification status badges, user detail with documents viewer, approve/reject verification buttons, suspend/ban actions, fraud flags

Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/finance/ pages: payment monitoring dashboard, deposit management table, penalty calculation form, revenue reports with date range filters, refund management, invoice generation button
Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/maintenance/ pages: maintenance schedule calendar view, service log table, add maintenance record form, spare part inventory, cost tracking charts
Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/promos/ pages: promo code list with usage stats, create/edit promo form (discount type, conditions, validity), referral system management, campaign creation
Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/cms/ pages: landing page section editor, blog post editor (rich text), FAQ management, banner management with image upload
Create apps/web/src/app/(admin)/reports/ pages: revenue report with exportable charts, fleet utilization report, driver retention metrics, profitability dashboard per vehicle
Create apps/web/src/stores/ with Zustand stores: useAuthStore, useBookingStore, useFleetStore, useNotificationStore - managing client-side state
Create apps/web/src/hooks/ with custom hooks: useAuth, useApi (TanStack Query wrapper), useMediaQuery, useDebounce, useIntersectionObserver
Create apps/web/src/middleware.ts with Next.js middleware for route protection based on authentication and role
acceptance_criteria: Running pnpm --filter web build compiles successfully
All dashboard pages render with proper layout and mock data
Admin pages show different UI from user dashboard pages
Role-based navigation shows correct menu items per role
Charts render with mock data using Recharts
Forms have proper validation with error messages
Mobile responsive layout works with bottom navigation
findings: Build compiles with 47 routes total (37 static, 5 dynamic, plus middleware at 34KB). Had to restructure admin routes from (admin) route group to /admin/ real path to avoid Next.js parallel route conflicts with (dashboard) routes. User dashboard uses (dashboard) route group at root level (/bookings, /dashboard, /payments, etc). Admin panel uses /admin/* with dedicated layout. Recharts wrapped in 'use client' components. All forms use react-hook-form + zod. Zustand stores for auth, sidebar, and notifications. Middleware handles auth/role protection. TailwindCSS v4 with @theme directive for custom colors (emerald/navy). First Load JS shared 103KB.
